status: DRAFT — PROPOSED for owner decision. Schema only: heat-disposition fields per subsystem, node mapping and closure rules. It carries no heat numbers; not wired into abep_sim (wiring is a model change for the owner).

milestones.A: names every heat path per subsystem and architecture so thermal conditions can be stated; no numbers
milestones.B: needs thermal_life inputs (thermal geometry, coil design, cathode data) and, for hall_discharge wall heat, an admitted member's design Hall map
milestones.C: needs instances for hot and cold cases from the integrated design, closing against the boundary P_bus

principle: rejected heat is not electrical input. Each subsystem's electrical input (bus_power_ledger_v1) is split into heat handed to the thermal network (Q_int_W), power exported to space without passing the network (P_exported_W: jet, plume, direct plasma radiation) and power transferred to another subsystem (P_transferred_W). Absorbed environmental heat (Q_env_absorbed_W) is a separate input that the radiator must also reject.

per_subsystem_fields.P_elec_in_W: value_record: load-plane electrical input (subsystem_ledger_v1 power.P_steady_W); converter losses are the ppu subsystem's input
per_subsystem_fields.Q_int_W: value_record: internal dissipation handed to the thermal network
per_subsystem_fields.P_exported_W: value_record: power leaving to space directly
per_subsystem_fields.P_received_W: {source_subsystem_id: value_record}: power received from another subsystem (mirror of the source's P_transferred_W)
per_subsystem_fields.Q_env_absorbed_W: value_record: solar + Earth IR + albedo + ram aero heating on the subsystem's external surfaces, per case (hot = sunlit, cold = eclipse)
per_subsystem_fields.Q_radiated_direct_W: value_record: heat the node radiates from its own external area
per_subsystem_fields.Q_to_radiator_W: value_record: heat conducted to the radiator node (G_to_rad x (T_node - T_rad))
per_subsystem_fields.T_node_K: value_record per case; T_max_K limit from the node definition

node_map.source: abep_sim/thermal.py:default_nodes, with the overrides in abep_sim/archengine.py:close_architecture (nodes[2] thruster = ledger['accelerator_body'], nodes[3] magnets = P_mag, nodes[4] stage1_source = ledger['ionizer'])

intake.Q_int_origin: none (0 W internal); environment + ram aero heating only

compressor.Q_int_origin: abep_sim/archengine.py:gas_path_state comp_power (whole electrical input booked as heat at this node)

thruster.Q_int_origin: abep_sim/archengine.py:close_architecture ledger['accelerator_body'] (0.6 x non-jet accelerator power)
thruster.status_for_hall: superseded (0-D Hall closure); TBD until an admitted member's design Hall map provides the wall heat flux

magnets.Q_int_origin: abep_sim/archengine.py:close_architecture P_mag (coil Joule heat); thruster radiative/conductive load onto the magnetic circuit is not modeled

stage1_source.Q_int_origin: abep_sim/archengine.py:close_architecture ledger['ionizer'] (source power not leaving as jet)

cathode.Q_int_origin: abep_sim/thermal.py:default_nodes 0.5 x P_cath_W (code constant); the other half is not assigned to any node or export term
cathode.execution_branch_note: abep_sim.thermal_life models the cathode node as keeper fraction + heater duty x heater power + emitter plasma heating, fed by boundary components cathode_keeper + cathode_heater; its inputs are TBD there. The archengine 0.5 x P_cath constant and gap G1 remain for the legacy trade view

ppu.note: P_loss_W lumps converter losses with controller_W + sensors_W; on bus_power_boundary_v1 the former are per-component losses (inside each efficiency) and the latter are the 'housekeeping' LOAD. Their heat still lands at the ppu node: a boundary component's P_loss_W is PPU/harness heat, its P_load_W is heat (or export) at the load subsystem

unassigned.note: no thermal node exists; their Q_int and Q_env_absorbed are TBD (filter, buffer, valves, xe_tank) or not_applicable (structure internal dissipation)

aux_load.note: the 5 W 'aux' ledger term has no node

exports.plume: abep_sim/archengine.py:close_architecture ledger['plume'] (0.4 x non-jet accelerator power, code constant, gap G18)

electrical_to_thermal.identity: for every subsystem: P_elec_in_W + sum P_received_W = Q_int_W + P_exported_W + sum P_transferred_W (+ P_stored_W in transients only)
electrical_to_thermal.system_identity: P_bus_W = sum_nodes Q_int_W + sum P_exported_W + P_unassigned_W, where P_unassigned_W is listed term by term (currently: 0.5 x P_neut at the cathode, gap G1; ledger['aux'], gap G2)
electrical_to_thermal.residual: resid_th = (P_bus_W - sum_nodes Q_int_W - sum P_exported_W - P_unassigned_W) / P_bus_W
electrical_to_thermal.gate: |resid_th| <= 0.02, the same tolerance as the archengine energy-ledger gate (CLAUDE.md rule 4); an instance with P_unassigned_W > 0 is reported as CLOSED_WITH_UNASSIGNED, never as fully closed

radiator_balance.identity: steady state per case: sum_nodes (Q_int_W + Q_env_absorbed_W - Q_radiated_direct_W) + Q_env_absorbed_radiator_W = Q_rejected_radiator_W
radiator_balance.producer: abep_sim/thermal.py:solve_network residuals (Newton on node temperatures); abep_sim/thermal.py:size_radiator returns P_waste_W = sum_nodes Q_int_W, which excludes absorbed environment
radiator_balance.note: per-node Q_env_absorbed_W, Q_radiated_direct_W and Q_to_radiator_W are computed inside solve_network but not returned (gap G19); until they are, the radiator balance is TBD at instance level

closure.no_double_count: each watt appears once: the jet share drawn from the source (from_src) is not also in stage1_source Q_int; a transferred power appears only as P_transferred_W at the source and P_received_W at the target

instance_required_fields.architecture: one of hall_only | rf_hall | ecr_hall (plus abep_sim/archengine.py:arch_name when derived from archengine)
instance_required_fields.closure_status: CLOSED | CLOSED_WITH_UNASSIGNED | NOT_EVALUABLE (a superseded Hall term) | OPEN
instance_required_fields.ensemble_member_id: required when thruster-node heat comes from an admitted member's design Hall map; null otherwise

thermal_life_crosswalk.source: abep_sim/thermal_life.py THERMAL_COMPONENTS and schemas/thermal_life/inputs_v1.json (execution branch e15f66f; read-only, resolved lazily)

ecr_magnet.note: archengine has no separate ECR-magnet heat; its single 'magnets' node carries P_mag only

thermal_life_crosswalk.not_covered_by_thermal_life: compressor, flow_control, thermal_control, housekeeping and PPU/converter losses (thermal_life NOT_COVERED lists 'PPU / converter losses (bus-power lane)'); their heat stays in this ledger's node_map (compressor, ppu) or is TBD (gaps G3, G4, G16)
thermal_life_crosswalk.rule: heat is booked once: a thermal_life component result replaces, never adds to, the legacy node value of the same subsystem in a given instance; the instance states which producer it used
